# Prose Pass

> Aleysian voice for writing intended for people.

**What it does.** Apply Aleysian voice to writing intended for people, including messages, reviews, tickets, UI copy, emails, proposals, decks, reports, and narrative artifacts. Use while drafting or rewriting human-facing prose and when gating a final human-facing file.

**Not for.** Do not use for AI instructions, indexes, ledgers, schemas, generated audit records, raw evidence, logs, code syntax, machine-readable data, quotations, or text that must remain verbatim. A file extension never selects this skill.
